baseline: Verified exact cumulative Cut22 ZIP (191 files, 125 inherited Node cases)

cases.risk: Concurrent labels overprint with no correction
cases.red: Cut22 two morphisms sharing endpoints have identical SVG text coordinates
cases.green: Opt-in arrow auto placement yields a distinct position while the manually positioned label retains its old x/y; actual Chromium import and render

cases.risk: Automatic placement overwrites author label or JSON semantics
cases.red: No per-arrow packing or manual-first placement exists in Cut22
cases.green: Pure model tests manual-first reservation, deterministic results, and actual exported native JSON retains exact refs and labelAvoid

cases.risk: Drag handle on automatic label jumps to base position
cases.red: The pre-Cut23 drag algorithm starts from stored labelDx/Dy, not the displayed automatically shifted coordinate
cases.green: Browser pointer drag preserves displayed starting position, switches labelAvoid off and creates one undoable manual edit; stationary click preserves mode

cases.red: A densely occupied label area has no clear candidate
cases.green: Deterministic crowded status, no text hiding; SVG amber/warning when unresolved

cases.risk: TikZ silently loses automatic label positions
cases.red: Cut22 TikZ supports fixed manual positions, not automatic screen-space displacements
cases.green: Unsupported visible automatically placed labels disable TikZ/PGF; SVG and native JSON remain available

cases.risk: Malformed optional property or legacy data loss
cases.red: No morphism-only labelAvoid property in Cut22 schema or runtime
cases.green: Strict schema and model boolean validation, nonmorphism rejection, older JSON absence preserves manual mode

cases.risk: Dense-label layout causes unbounded spatial index memory
cases.red: Large rectangles can span thousands of screen-space buckets
cases.green: Bucket key caps, bounded overflow accounting and explicit crowded status for unindexable labels

cases.risk: An opt-in flag on an unlabeled arrow unnecessarily disables a faithful TikZ export
cases.red: Initial canTikz() gating used the flag even when the morphism text was empty and no screen-space label existed
cases.green: TikZ remains available for otherwise-supported unlabeled morphisms; real Chromium export-button regression added

verification.scope: Isolated Chromium page.set_content, not deployed site
verification.performance_benchmark: Isolated Chromium 180-node/80-arrow SVG rebuild: manual median 12.25ms, automatic median 12.95ms
verification.result: PASS in isolated Chromium and Node; see cut23-browser-results.json
